_note: adm-bing-2 is a product photo of a framed airport-map poster (skybirdsupply.com), not the airport itself.

adm-bing-1.webp.zh: 从空中俯瞰阿德莫尔市机场：两条跑道在草地上交叉，航站楼与机库集中在场地西南侧。
adm-bing-1.webp.en: Airborne view of Ardmore Municipal Airport — two runways crossing over green fields, the terminal and hangars clustered on the south-west side.

adm-bing-3.webp.zh: 机场入口的标识墙：石砌基座上写着「ARDMORE MUNICIPAL AIRPORT」，旁边是驻场企业的名录牌。
adm-bing-3.webp.en: The entrance sign at Ardmore Municipal Airport — the name on a stone base beside a directory of airport businesses.

adm-doubao-01.webp.zh: 从轻型飞机舷窗俯瞰，阿德莫尔市机场的跑道在绿野上交叉，一条河从林间蜿蜒而过。
adm-doubao-01.webp.en: Seen past the wing strut of a light aircraft, Ardmore Municipal's runways cross green fields while a river bends through the trees.

adm-doubao-02.webp.zh: 黑白老照片从低空拍下机场：交叉的跑道、成排的机库与营房散布在田野之间。
adm-doubao-02.webp.en: An old black-and-white aerial photograph shows the field's crossing runways, with rows of hangars and support buildings spread across open farmland.

adm-doubao-03.webp.zh: 美国联邦航空局的机场平面图，标出阿德莫尔市机场两条跑道的方位、标高与滑行道。
adm-doubao-03.webp.en: A Federal Aviation Administration airport diagram lays out Ardmore Municipal's two runways, taxiways, elevations and magnetic headings.

adm-doubao-04.webp.zh: 谷歌地图截图用红色标记指出机场大致位置，四周是施普林格与吉恩奥特里之间的公路和农田。
adm-doubao-04.webp.en: A Google Maps screenshot marks the airport's approximate location with a red pin among highways and farmland between Springer and Gene Autry.
